summary: Repaired node1’s support-bundle exporter and verified it persists across reboot. It now redacts email addresses and auth_token values, preserves timestamps/event types/ticket IDs, exports nested logs, and excludes symlinks outside logs/. Source data, RHEL 10.0, and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Replaced the unsafe recursive copy with a Python 3 exporter using the platform’s existing runtime.
Kept bin/export executable and accepting the output directory as its sole argument.
Verified sanitized top-level and nested output, external-symlink rejection, and unchanged source checksums.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed a changed boot identity and full post-restart recovery.

evidence.requirement: Redact every email address and auth_token value while retaining timestamps, event types, and ticket IDs
evidence.summary: Exact exported records contain [REDACTED] while preserving both timestamps, login/update event types, and T100/T101 ticket IDs; checks passed before and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Include nested logs and reject symlinks leading outside logs/
evidence.summary: Baseline identified logs/private-link -> ../private.txt. Export contains app.log and archive/events.log, omits private-link/private.txt, and reports the external link as skipped.

evidence.requirement: Keep source logs and private sibling file unchanged; preserve installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: All three source SHA-256 checksums match before repair, after repair, and after reboot. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 are unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Entrypoint bin/export takes the output directory argument and remains executable
evidence.summary: The repaired entrypoint compiled successfully, executed end-to-end with a temporary output-directory argument, and remained mode 0755 after reboot.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot ID e625b9a5-4242-499a-88da-9a76ecf86fe1 had a running system and healthy export. Safe reboot was acknowledged. Boot ID changed to 14ab762b-3d55-4085-9265-649c7fb7f66e, after which system state, exporter behavior, source data, and platform version all verified healthy.
